resolution.note: evals/d23/preregistration.md committed; runs.ts --confirmatory refuses without it and its sha256 (exit 64)

title: The K vs PB run starts only from a committed preregistered decision rule
body:
Why: Fable plan 2026-11-14 (risk D): the K vs PB confirmatory run on 33 units is underpowered (~60% base rates, a true +9 pp most likely returns "not shown"), and nothing says what that outcome triggers; the lead would tune K and rerun on the same units, burning the last untouched set.
Outcome: before t-p70b19s runs, evals/d23 commits a preregistration: the decision rule for each outcome (K better, equivalent, not shown, worse), the power at the planned unit count, and a source of fresh units outside the D23 set (pilot repositories with hidden tests and a PB arm).
Proof: a test that the t-p70b19s runner refuses to start without the committed preregistration file and its hash; npm run fast PASS.
